title: KTH-ID2223 : Scalable Machine Learning and Deep Learning Course
summary: A KTH course repository containing multiple lab exercises and a final League-of-Legends match-outcome prediction project built with scalable ML/DL pipelines. One lab's daily feature pipeline for a wine-quality dataset calls SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, with metadata auto-detected via SingleTableMetadata, to generate synthetic wine rows for simulated daily ingestion.
evidence: Lab1/Task2/daily-wine-feature-pipeline.py:20-33 uses `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer` and calls CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=6) to synthesize wine data
needs: SDV usage is confined to a single lab pipeline distinct from the repo's main League of Legends project; broader relevance of SDV to the repo overall is limited.
